nodes.label: words-1.6 prompt version
nodes.rationale: 1.3's teaching body verbatim with only turn-taking rewritten. 1.4 and 1.5 lost because slicing turns and a maxTokens ceiling hurt teaching; turnTimeoutSeconds is 3 (the floor) with patient eagerness; maxTokens is left unset because a limiter with no prompt budget truncates mid-word.

nodes.label: End session button fix (hangup first)
nodes.rationale: End was blocked behind an untimed apiFetch/getToken network call, and persist-first reasoning was stale because the lock-screen End was removed. Persistence is still covered by onDisconnect, the on-disk journal and the post-call webhook.

nodes.label: LessonItem wordId and translationRu, itemLine
nodes.rationale: Both fields are nullable because an optimistic row has no word id (resolve_words needs Postgres) and the translation arrives from the enrichment job. The first two translations are joined server-side so there is one rule instead of a slice per client.

nodes.label: Lock-screen Live Activity card redesign
nodes.rationale: Option A kept words as [String] and pre-joined in JS, so the ContentState Codable contract is unchanged across both targets. The controls hint was deleted outright to save space. ACTIVITY_WORD_WINDOW is held at 6 pending a device height measurement.

nodes.label: Lesson Words panel with links, translations, close icon, confirm dialog
nodes.rationale: CloseIcon is deliberately not TrashIcon, because removing a lesson_items row keeps the word whereas the trash deletes it from the account.
